Subject: Pricing packet — Redwood deck for QuantaPlane

Hi Sara / Alex,

Great to speak yesterday — thanks for the time and the helpful context on your inference latency and cost targets. Per our call I attached a tailored pricing packet and a short summary of options for Hosted vs Dedicated. Quick highlights: 
- Expected token cost (hosted): ~$0.0018 / token for p90 workload (see page 4)
- Dedicated baseline: estimated 4 GPUs for steady 200 reqs/min with predictable latency
- Suggested first step: pilot on hosted with KV-prefix caching enabled, then migrate to Dedicated as throughput stabilizes

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Deck_QuantaPlane_v3.pdf (deck, 12 slides)

If it helps, I can walk through the deck in 15 minutes and call out the ops/SLAs and cost tradeoffs — available Mon/Tue afternoon PT. Are you still prioritizing this this quarter? My proposed next action: 15-min walkthrough + confirm security checklist owner so we can start SOC2 + IP discussions if you want to move forward.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
